user.title: Which Wiser hub?
user.description: More than one Wiser hub is set up. Rooms are discovered from the hub you choose.

rooms.title: Wiser Predictive: {hub}
rooms.description: Rooms found on {hub}. Untick any you do not want. The Predictive Heating panel in the sidebar draws each room against the outside temperature and the forecast: choose the weather entity (forecast) and, if you have one, an outside temperature sensor (otherwise the weather entity's temperature is used). Heat is needed when a room is at or below its minimum plus the trigger margin. To be told, choose a script; it is called with a `message` variable plus anything you put in the extra data.
